content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CMHO Bilaspur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh) (CMHO Bilaspur) for filling various medical and healthcare vacancies on a contractual basis under the health department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CMHO Bilaspu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies available across multiple posts including Physiotherapist, Psychologist, Radiographer, and Dentist under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for CMHO Bilaspu Recruitment 2026 is Walk-in. Eligible and interested candidates can directly attend the interview at the designated venue on the specified date along with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the advertised posts is scheduled to be held on 09 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they report to the venue on time.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligible qualifications for the Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Psychologist post must hold an M.Phil in Clinical Psychology or M.Sc Psychology/M.Sc Rehabilitation Psychology/M.A Psychology with RCI registration and 2 years of experience in a mental health hospital or clinic.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts under CMHO Bilaspu Recruitment 2026 is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 64 years. Age is calculated as per the guidelines specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to attend the walk-in?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, or ST candidates. The application fee for all categories is Nil.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging between Rs. 15,000 and Rs. 31,500 per month depending on the specific post and qualification requirements.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original educational certificates, professional degree certificates, Council/RCI registration cards, experience certificates, identity proof, and self-attested photocopies of all documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website for updates?
faq.answer: You can check all official updates, venue details, and download notifications by visiting the official website of Bilaspur district at http://bilaspur.gov.in.
